title: Task Installer Configuration
description: Configuration for IPED processing task installation and ordering (TaskInstaller.toml)

tasks.description: Ordered list of processing pipeline entries. Order is critical - some tasks depend on results of others. Entries ending in .js or .py are scripts from the scripts/tasks folder; any other entry is a fully qualified task class name implementing AbstractTask.

items.description: Task class name (e.g. iped.engine.task.HashTask) or script file name (e.g. RefineCategoryTask.js)
